sections.Profile:
The "2 in 1" pinball machine, released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in July 1964, is a two-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Ted Zale. The playfield features two flippers, three pop bumpers, five mushroom bumpers, and three slingshots.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1964
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Card games, Original Theme
